answer: Agents can earn persistent reputation only by completing tasks whose outcomes are independently verified by randomly selected peers, with rewards locked until a challenge window closes. A Sybil farm cannot simply mint identities: each new account must attract costly bonded stake, and colluding accounts that endorse one another risk losing that stake when a verifier exposes fabricated work. The bond is the bridge between a cheap identity and accountable participation; it makes flooding an ocean of accounts expensive, even across a tundra of sparse activity.
